incoming.name: Australia
incoming.excerpt: The dingo was introduced by Austronesian people that traded with Indigenous Australians around 4000 BCE.

incoming.name: Australian English
incoming.excerpt: Some elements of Aboriginal languages have been incorporated into Australian English, mainly as names for places, flora and fauna (for example dingo, kangaroo).

outgoing.name: Australia
outgoing.excerpt: It is commonly described as an Australian wild dog, but is not restricted to Australia, nor did it originate there.

outgoing.name: Sydney
outgoing.excerpt: The name dingo comes from the language of the Eora Aboriginal people, who were the original inhabitants of the Sydney area.

outgoing.name: Vietnam
outgoing.excerpt: The earliest known dingo skulls have been found in Vietnam and are about 5,500 years old.
